env_aws_target:
# AWS EC2 target for BVCRSA experiments
#
# Update the three values below when the instance changes. Scripts and the
# experiment harness read this file; nothing hardcodes an IP or key path.
# harness.py stamps AWS_HOST into every result CSV so each run records the
# machine it came from (answers R1-C5 / R3-15 on consistent hardware).

AWS_HOST=ec2-<PUBLIC-IP>.<region>.compute.amazonaws.com
AWS_USER=ubuntu
AWS_KEY=C:/Users/Jzguyr/.ssh/bvcrsa-key.pem

# Instance details â€” copy into the paper's Experimental Setup (F9)
AWS_INSTANCE_TYPE=c7i.2xlarge
AWS_VCPU=8
AWS_RAM_GB=16
AWS_OS=Ubuntu 22.04 LTS

# Remote working directory
AWS_REMOTE_DIR=/home/ubuntu/bvcrsa
